disputed_verses.BHSA 1CH 25:18: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂ֣ר עֲזַרְאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃
disputed_verses.KJV 1CH 25:18: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:

first_reader_said: 1CH 25:18: Both records are the Azarel who drew the eleventh lot among the singers.

why: 1CH 12:6 identifies A in the roster of Korahites who joined David’s fighting force. 1CH 25:18 identifies B as the head of the eleventh musical course in Heman’s family, a separate roster identity. Shared Korahite ancestry does not establish that these men were identical; 1CH 25:18 should belong to B alone.
